items.title: George "Pops" Foster and Mugsy Spanier Interview, 1957-04-21
items.q: The interviewer mentions 'Jones' home' and 'Jones' in the context of the interviewer's own past experiences ('I used to go back there', 'I'd do my dirt, man. Get up a little bit more and go back to Jones' home'). The interviewee does not mention Jones, nor does the interviewee respond to the intervi

ctx.x: It was funny back then, the reform school. I should have been under that reform school. I used to go back there and help them guys sweep out that long hall so they could hit the rehearsal of the band. Did you play with that band? I tried to play bass drum. I tried everything back there with them. I'd do my dirt, man. Get up a little bit more and go back to Jones' home. Walk by that long walk, too. Where were you yesterday all day at Jones' home, what you was doing out there, sweeping up the rehearsal of the band,…
I used to like to play the brass band. I started out as a drummer recently.
